title: Chickpea Tagine with Mediterranean Flair
description: A hearty and aromatic North African stew made with chickpeas, velvety eggplant, and a blend of Mediterranean spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Sauté onion and garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add sliced eggplant and cook, stirring occasionally, until it starts to brown, about 10 minutes.
Add chickpeas, tagine spice blend, salt, and pepper; stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the eggplant is tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with parsley if desired.
